summary: Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone strikes across central and eastern Ukraine, hitting Kremenchuk, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia, while Ukrainian long-range UAVs reached the Caspian Sea forcing Russian naval defenses. The US approved transfer of 10 Patriot interceptors from Germany, and the EU pledged €3.3 billion for missiles and drones. Russian sources claim capture of Rozovka in Zaporizhzhia and Malaya Volchya in Kharkiv region.
key_points: Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs against Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/78786)
An airstrike hit the Epicentr supermarket in Kharkiv. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33348)
Four cruise missiles struck Kremenchuk, with at least one impact confirmed. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75078)
Ukrainian long-range drones forced Russian ships in the Caspian Sea to deploy protective netting. (Source: @eRadarrua/114175)
Russian Ministry of Defense reported capture of Rozovka in Zaporizhzhia region and Malaya Volchya in Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33325)
US State Department approved transfer of 10 Patriot missiles from Germany valued at $29.6 million. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33343)
European Commission announced €3.3 billion allocation for Ukrainian missile and drone procurement. (Source: @UkraineNow/84152)
Polish Prime Minister Tusk warned of Russian hybrid drone and missile attacks on Ukraine's supporters. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33349)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched coordinated missile and drone strikes across central and eastern Ukraine, hitting Kremenchuk, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia, while Ukrainian long-range UAVs reached the Caspian Sea forcing Russian naval defenses. The US approved transfer of 10 Patriot interceptors from Germany, and the EU pledged €3.3 billion for missiles and drones. Russian sources claim capture of Rozovka in Zaporizhzhia and Malaya Volchya in Kharkiv region.

points: Ukrainian long-range UAVs conducted strikes deep inside Russian territory, reaching the Caspian Sea at Kaspiysk, Dagestan, forcing Russian naval vessels to deploy protective netting against drone attacks (Source: @eRadarrua/114175). Ukrainian air defense units engaged multiple incoming Russian cruise missiles and jet-powered Shahed drones across central and northern regions, with impacts reported in Kremenchuk and Obukhiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75081, @mon1tor_ua/75064). The Ukrainian government added Kyiv and Kyiv region to the list of territories with elevated war risk to expand war risk insurance programs for businesses (Source: @UkraineNow/84145). A corruption investigation revealed officials in the Borodyansk community stole 25 million hryvnia from the eRecovery program by registering undamaged houses as destroyed, with 14 suspects identified (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33330). The Ministry of Finance postponed winter energy sector preparation spending until December due to funding shortages, deferring capital expenditures for hospital construction, shelters, energy infrastructure protection, and social housing (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33340). Polish Deputy Defense Minister Pavel Zalewski confirmed preparation of a new €50 million military aid package including Patriot missile interceptors for Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84143).

Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs against Zaporizhzhia region, while cruise missiles designated "Banderyol" were fired from Crimea toward the Odesa coastline targeting Chornomorske (Source: @kpszsu/78786, @eRadarrua/114144). Russian forces struck the Amstor shopping mall in Zaporizhzhia causing a large-scale fire, with casualties and damage still being assessed (Source: @eRadarrua/114138). The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Rozovka settlement in Zaporizhzhia region and control of Malaya Volchya village in Kharkiv region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33325). A massive Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow overnight was described by TASS as one of the largest in several years, prompting temporary suspension of polling stations in Sochi (Source: @tass_agency/395945, @tass_agency/395946). Russian authorities reported a detainee accused of sabotage preparation in Kabardino-Balkaria was transferred to Russia via humanitarian exchange with Ukraine (Source: @tass_agency/395941). Russian elections for State Duma and regional bodies commenced, including first-time voting in occupied Donbas and Novorossiya territories (Source: @tass_agency/395925).

Russian forces advanced near Bilytske in the Donetsk direction according to updated frontline mapping (Source: @DeepStateUA/23838). The Russian Defense Ministry announced capture of Rozovka in Zaporizhzhia region and Malaya Volchya in Kharkiv region, indicating incremental territorial gains (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33325). Russian guided aerial bomb strikes targeted Zaporizhzhia region, while barrage munitions "Banderyol" were launched from southern Kharkiv region westward toward Poltava region (Source: @kpszsu/78786, @kpszsu/78782). Ukrainian defense forces reportedly struck two Russian launch installations in Bryansk region and temporarily occupied territories (Source: @UkraineNow/84153). Over 15 UAV launches were detected from various locations, with the majority of jet-powered drones originating from Donetsk area (Source: @eRadarrua/114160).

Multiple jet-powered UAVs were tracked across northern Ukraine: in Chernihiv region near Horodnya moving toward Chernihiv, near Ripky heading southwest, past Olshivka southwest, and a new contact heading toward Slavutych (Source: @kpszsu/78748, @kpszsu/78757, @kpszsu/78781, @eRadarrua/114146). In Kyiv region, jet UAVs approached Bucha and Irpin from the north, with another near Kaharlyk on northern course toward Kyiv, and one past Kaharlyk toward Obukhiv where a warehouse strike was preliminarily reported (Source: @kpszsu/78754, @kpszsu/78778, @eRadarrua/114158, @mon1tor_ua/75064). Zhytomyr region experienced repeated jet Shahed incursions: one entering Zhytomyr city, another past Ovruch westward, one from Rivne region toward Volyn via Sarny, and one from Chornobyl zone toward Korosten (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75072, @kpszsu/78769, @mon1tor_ua/75067, @eRadarrua/114146). Air raid alerts were issued and later cleared in Kyiv at 20:44 and 22:09 on 17.09.2026 with drone threat at yellow level (Source: @eRadarrua/114106, @eRadarrua/114127).

Four cruise missiles "Banderyol" were launched from Crimea toward the Odesa coastline, preliminarily targeting Chornomorske (Source: @eRadarrua/114144). Russian forces attacked a Tanzanian-flagged vessel heading to a Ukrainian port, killing the captain and wounding three crew members (Source: @UkraineNow/84140). Ukrainian long-range drones reached the Caspian Sea at Kaspiysk, Dagestan, hundreds of kilometers from the front line, forcing Russian naval vessels to deploy protective netting (Source: @eRadarrua/114175). A jet-powered Shahed was detected circling near Odesa maritime area, while another from Kherson region moved toward Black Sea waters (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75071).

Russian forces employed a mix of cruise missiles ("Banderyol") and jet-powered Shahed drones in large-scale strikes: four missiles hit Kremenchuk with confirmed impacts, while over 15 UAVs launched from multiple locations including Donetsk (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75078, @mon1tor_ua/75079, @eRadarrua/114160). Guided aerial bombs were dropped by Russian tactical aviation on Zaporizhzhia region, and barrage munitions "Banderyol" launched from southern Kharkiv region westward (Source: @kpszsu/78786, @kpszsu/78782). Ukrainian air defense engaged targets across at least eight oblasts: Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Dnipropetrovsk, Rivne, Chernihiv, and Odesa (Source: @eRadarrua/114157, @eRadarrua/114156, @eRadarrua/114158, @mon1tor_ua/75071). The US State Department approved transfer of 10 Patriot PAC-3 interceptors from Germany worth $29.6 million, noting two interceptors are required per ballistic missile intercept (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33343). Poland confirmed preparation of its largest military aid package including Patriot interceptors, with Deputy Defense Minister Zalewski citing a €50 million package (Source: @UkraineNow/84143, @UkraineNow/84151). The European Commission pledged an additional €3.3 billion for Ukrainian missile and drone procurement (Source: @UkraineNow/84152).

key_developments: Russian cruise missiles struck Kremenchuk with four "Banderyol" missiles, causing at least one confirmed impact in the city while a second missile entered the urban area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75078, @mon1tor_ua/75081).
